title: प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृतमाथि पालिका भाँडेको आरोप, ६ महिनादेखि गाउँसभा ठप्प
content:
रौतहट । यमुनामाई गाउँपालिकामा जनप्रतिनिधिबीचको विवाद र प्रशासनिक असमझदारीले स्थानीय सरकारको कामकाज ठप्पप्रायः बनेको छ । आर्थिक वर्ष सुरु भएको करिब ६ महिना बितिसक्दा पनि गाउँसभा हुन नसक्दा विकास निर्माण, कर्मचारीको तलब र सर्वसाधारणले पाउने दैनिक सेवासमेत प्रभावित भएका छन् । गाउँपालिकाभित्र देखिएको विवाद समाधान गर्नुको साटो प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत बृजनन्दन साहले नै जनप्रतिनिधिबीच द्वन्द्व बढाउने काम गरेको आरोप वडा नं. ४ का वडाध्यक्ष चेतन राय यादवले लगाएका छन् । वडाध्यक्ष यादवका अनुसार प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत साहले निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधिबीच आपसी मनमुटाव बढाएर एकअर्कालाई प्रतिस्पर्धी बनाउने र आफूअनुकूल वातावरण तयार गर्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छन् । प्रशासनिक नेतृत्वले जनप्रतिनिधिबीच समन्वय र सहकार्यको वातावरण बनाउनुपर्नेमा राजनीतिक चलखेलमा लागेको उनको आरोप छ । यादवले गाउँपालिकाको प्रशासनिक तथा विकास निर्माणका कामलाई प्राथमिकता दिनुपर्ने प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ र सुविधामा केन्द्रित हुँदा पालिकाको अवस्था अस्तव्यस्त बनेको दाबी गरेका छन् । ६ महिनासम्म गाउँसभा भएन स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी कानुनी व्यवस्थाअनुसार प्रत्येक स्थानीय तहले असार १० गतेभित्र आगामी आर्थिक वर्षको बजेट सभामा पेस गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ । तर, यमुनामाईमा आन्तरिक विवादकै कारण आर्थिक वर्ष सुरु भएको महिनौँ बितिसक्दा पनि गाउँसभा हुन सकेको छैन । गाउँसभा नहुँदा वार्षिक बजेट तथा कार्यक्रम पारित हुन नसकेको र नयाँ विकास योजनाको कार्यान्वयनमा समस्या भएको वडाध्यक्ष यादवले बताए । यसको असर गाउँपालिकामा कार्यरत कर्मचारीको तलबभत्तादेखि विकास निर्माणका योजनासम्म परेको उनको भनाइ छ । गाउँपालिकाको नेतृत्वले विवाद समाधान गरी सभा सम्पन्न गर्नुपर्नेमा उल्टै विवाद लम्ब्याउने काम भइरहेको यादवको आरोप छ । तालाबन्दीले सेवाग्राहीलाई सास्ती जनप्रतिनिधिबीचको विवाद अब कार्यालयको कामकाजमा समेत देखिन थालेको छ । बन्दसत्रको नाममा गाउँपालिका कार्यालयमा तालाबन्दी गरिएको र जिम्मेवार पदाधिकारी कार्यालयमा उपस्थित हुन नसक्ने अवस्था सिर्जना हुँदा नागरिकले सामान्य सेवा लिनसमेत कठिनाइ भोग्नुपरेको यादवले बताए । जन्मदर्ता, मृत्यु दर्ता, विवाह दर्ता, बसाइँसराइ, विभिन्न सिफारिस तथा सामाजिक सुरक्षा भत्तासम्बन्धी काम प्रभावित भएको उनको भनाइ छ । जनताको करबाट सञ्चालन हुने सार्वजनिक कार्यालयलाई व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ पूरा गर्ने थलो बनाउन नहुने भन्दै यादवले कार्यालय बन्द गरेर नागरिकलाई दुःख दिने कार्य स्वीकार्य नहुने बताए । ७० हजारको प्रलोभन देखाएर हस्ताक्षर संकलन ? गाउँपालिकाको विवाद आर्थिक पारदर्शिता र निर्णय प्रक्रियामा समेत जोडिएको छ । वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिकाको आयव्यय सार्वजनिक गर्न पटकपटक माग गर्दा पनि बेवास्ता गरिएको आरोप लगाएका छन् । उनका अनुसार केही वडाध्यक्ष तथा कार्यपालिका सदस्यलाई आफ्नो पक्षमा पार्न गोप्य रूपमा रजिस्टर घरघरमा पुर्‍याएर हस्ताक्षर संकलन गर्ने काम भइरहेको छ । बहुमत जुटाउने उद्देश्यले केही जनप्रतिनिधिलाई ७० हजार रुपैयाँसम्म दिने प्रलोभन देखाइएको समेत यादवको दाबी छ । यद्यपि, रकमको प्रलोभन देखाइएको आरोपबारे स्वतन्त्र पुष्टि हुन सकेको छैन । यस विषयमा सम्बन्धित पक्षको आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया पनि सार्वजनिक भएको छैन । अध्यक्षमाथि पनि मनपरी निर्णयको आरोप वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिका अध्यक्ष महम्मद साउद र केही वडाध्यक्षको मिलेमतोमा आफूखुसी निर्णय तथा कामकारबाही भइरहेको आरोपसमेत लगाएका छन् । उनका अनुसार गाउँपालिकाका निर्णय सामूहिक सहमति, आर्थिक पारदर्शिता र कानुनी प्रक्रियाअनुसार हुनुपर्ने भए पनि केही व्यक्तिको स्वार्थका कारण पालिकाको कामकाज प्रभावित भएको छ । जनता भने सेवाबाट वञ्चित गाउँपालिकाभित्रको विवाद लम्बिँदै जाँदा सर्वसाधारण नागरिक प्रत्यक्ष मारमा परेका छन् । सामान्य सिफारिसदेखि व्यक्तिगत घटना दर्तासम्मका कामका लागि कार्यालय पुग्ने सेवाग्राहीले सेवा नपाउने अवस्था आउनु स्थानीय सरकारको जिम्मेवारीमाथिकै प्रश्न भएको स्थानीयवासीको गुनासो छ । जनप्रतिनिधि र कर्मचारीको विवादका कारण नागरिकले दुःख पाउन नहुने भन्दै स्थानीयले तत्काल कार्यालय सञ्चालन र नियमित सेवा प्रवाहको व्यवस्था गर्न माग गरेका छन् । यमुनामाई गाउँपालिकामा देखिएको विवादले स्थानीय सरकारको कार्यसम्पादनमाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाएको छ । गाउँसभा हुन नसक्नु, बजेट तथा विकास निर्माण प्रभावित हुनु र नागरिकले आधारभूत सेवा पाउनसमेत कठिनाइ भोग्नुले पालिकाको प्रशासनिक अवस्था कमजोर बनेको देखिन्छ । वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिकाको आर्थिक कारोबार सार्वजनिक गर्न, जनप्रतिनिधिबीच सहकार्यको वातावरण बनाउन तथा प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत साहको कार्यशैलीबारे निष्पक्ष छानबिन गर्न सम्बन्धित निकायसँग माग गरेका छन् । Rautahat. Disputes and administrative misunderstandings between people's representatives in Yamunamai Rural Municipality have brought the functioning of the local government to a standstill. Even after nearly six months of the start of the fiscal year, the failure to hold village assemblies has affected development, construction, employee salaries, and even the daily services provided to the general public. Chetan Ray Yadav, ward chairman of Ward No. 4, has accused Chief Administrative Officer Brijanandan Sah of inciting conflict among the people's representatives instead of resolving the dispute within the rural municipality. According to Ward Chairman Yadav, Chief Administrative Officer Sah is trying to create an environment favorable to him by increasing mutual disagreements among elected representatives, making them competitive with each other and creating an environment favorable to him. He alleges that the administrative leadership is engaging in political maneuvering when it should create an environment of coordination and cooperation among representatives. Yadav has claimed that the situation in the municipality has become chaotic as the Chief Administrative Officer, who should have prioritized the administrative and development work of the rural municipality, has focused on personal interests and convenience. There was no village assembly for 6 months. According to the legal provisions related to the operation of local government, each local level is required to submit the budget for the upcoming fiscal year to the assembly by Asad 10. However, due to internal disputes in Yamunamai, the village assembly has not been held even after months of the start of the fiscal year. Ward Chairman Yadav said that due to the absence of a village assembly, the annual budget and programs could not be passed and there were problems in the implementation of the new development plan. He said that this has affected everything from the salaries and allowances of employees working in the rural municipality to development and construction plans. Yadav alleges that instead of the rural municipality leadership resolving the dispute and holding the meeting, the dispute is being prolonged. Lockdown causes hardship to service recipients Disputes between public representatives have now started to be seen in office operations as well. Yadav said that citizens are facing difficulties in availing even basic services as the rural municipality office has been locked in the name of closed session and responsible officials are unable to attend the office. He said that work related to birth registration, death registration, marriage registration, migration, various recommendations, and social security allowances has been affected. Stating that a public office run by the people's taxes should not be made a place to fulfill personal interests, Yadav said that causing suffering to citizens by closing the office is unacceptable. Collecting signatures by offering the lure of 70,000? The dispute in the rural municipality is also linked to financial transparency and decision-making processes. Ward Chairman Yadav has alleged that despite repeated demands to make the rural municipality's income and expenditure public, they have been ignored. According to him, work is being done to secretly collect signatures by taking the register door-to-door to win over some ward chairmen and executive members. Yadav also claims that some people's representatives have been tempted to pay up to Rs 70,000 with the aim of gaining a majority. However, the allegations of financial inducements have not been independently confirmed, and no official response from the parties involved has been made public. The chairman is also accused of arbitrary decisions. Ward Chairman Yadav has also accused the rural municipality chairman Muhammad Saud and some ward chairmen of making arbitrary decisions and taking arbitrary actions. According to him, although decisions of the rural municipality should be made according to collective consensus, financial transparency, and legal process, the functioning of the municipality has been affected due to the vested interests of a few individuals. The people are deprived of services. As the dispute within the rural municipality drags on, ordinary citizens are directly affected. Locals complain that the situation where service recipients who visit the office for tasks ranging from general recommendations to individual incident registration are not receiving services is a question of the responsibility of the local government. Stating that citizens should not suffer due to disputes between public representatives and employees, locals have demanded immediate office operations and arrangements for regular service delivery. The controversy in Yamunamai Rural Municipality has raised serious questions about the performance of the local government. The administrative situation of the municipality appears to have become weak due to the inability to hold village assemblies, the impact on budget and development projects, and the difficulty for citizens to access even basic services. Ward Chairman Yadav has demanded that the concerned bodies make the financial transactions of the rural municipality public, create an environment of cooperation among public representatives, and conduct an impartial investigation into the working style of Chief Administrative Officer Sah.

जुटाउने उद्देश्यले केही जनप्रतिनिधिलाई ७० हजार रुपैयाँसम्म दिने प्रलोभन देखाइएको समेत यादवको दाबी छ । यद्यपि, रकमको प्रलोभन देखाइएको आरोपबारे स्वतन्त्र पुष्टि हुन सकेको छैन । यस विषयमा सम्बन्धित पक्षको आधिकारिक प्रतिक्रिया पनि सार्वजनिक भएको छैन । अध्यक्षमाथि पनि मनपरी निर्णयको आरोप वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिका अध्यक्ष महम्मद साउद र केही वडाध्यक्षको मिलेमतोमा आफूखुसी निर्णय तथा कामकारबाही भइरहेको आरोपसमेत लगाएका छन् । उनका अनुसार गाउँपालिकाका निर्णय सामूहिक सहमति, आर्थिक पारदर्शिता र कानुनी प्रक्रियाअनुसार हुनुपर्ने भए पनि केही व्यक्तिको स्वार्थका कारण पालिकाको कामकाज प्रभावित भएको छ । जनता भने सेवाबाट वञ्चित गाउँपालिकाभित्रको विवाद लम्बिँदै जाँदा सर्वसाधारण नागरिक प्रत्यक्ष मारमा परेका छन् । सामान्य सिफारिसदेखि व्यक्तिगत घटना दर्तासम्मका कामका लागि कार्यालय पुग्ने सेवाग्राहीले सेवा नपाउने अवस्था आउनु स्थानीय सरकारको जिम्मेवारीमाथिकै प्रश्न भएको स्थानीयवासीको गुनासो छ । जनप्रतिनिधि र कर्मचारीको विवादका कारण नागरिकले दुःख पाउन नहुने भन्दै स्थानीयले तत्काल कार्यालय सञ्चालन र नियमित सेवा प्रवाहको व्यवस्था गर्न माग गरेका छन् । यमुनामाई गाउँपालिकामा देखिएको विवादले स्थानीय सरकारको कार्यसम्पादनमाथि गम्भीर प्रश्न उठाएको छ । गाउँसभा हुन नसक्नु, बजेट तथा विकास निर्माण प्रभावित हुनु र नागरिकले आधारभूत सेवा पाउनसमेत कठिनाइ भोग्नुले पालिकाको प्रशासनिक अवस्था कमजोर बनेको देखिन्छ । वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिकाको आर्थिक कारोबार सार्वजनिक गर्न, जनप्रतिनिधिबीच सहकार्यको वातावरण बनाउन तथा प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत साहको कार्यशैलीबारे निष्पक्ष छानबिन गर्न सम्बन्धित निकायसँग माग गरेका छन् ।

रौतहट । यमुनामाई गाउँपालिकामा जनप्रतिनिधिबीचको विवाद र प्रशासनिक असमझदारीले स्थानीय सरकारको कामकाज ठप्पप्रायः बनेको छ ।

आर्थिक वर्ष सुरु भएको करिब ६ महिना बितिसक्दा पनि गाउँसभा हुन नसक्दा विकास निर्माण, कर्मचारीको तलब र सर्वसाधारणले पाउने दैनिक सेवासमेत प्रभावित भएका छन् ।

गाउँपालिकाभित्र देखिएको विवाद समाधान गर्नुको साटो प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत बृजनन्दन साहले नै जनप्रतिनिधिबीच द्वन्द्व बढाउने काम गरेको आरोप वडा नं. ४ का वडाध्यक्ष चेतन राय यादवले लगाएका छन् ।

वडाध्यक्ष यादवका अनुसार प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत साहले निर्वाचित जनप्रतिनिधिबीच आपसी मनमुटाव बढाएर एकअर्कालाई प्रतिस्पर्धी बनाउने र आफूअनुकूल वातावरण तयार गर्ने प्रयास गरिरहेका छन् । प्रशासनिक नेतृत्वले जनप्रतिनिधिबीच समन्वय र सहकार्यको वातावरण बनाउनुपर्नेमा राजनीतिक चलखेलमा लागेको उनको आरोप छ ।

यादवले गाउँपालिकाको प्रशासनिक तथा विकास निर्माणका कामलाई प्राथमिकता दिनुपर्ने प्रमुख प्रशासकीय अधिकृत व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ र सुविधामा केन्द्रित हुँदा पालिकाको अवस्था अस्तव्यस्त बनेको दाबी गरेका छन् ।

६ महिनासम्म गाउँसभा भएन स्थानीय सरकार सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी कानुनी व्यवस्थाअनुसार प्रत्येक स्थानीय तहले असार १० गतेभित्र आगामी आर्थिक वर्षको बजेट सभामा पेस गर्नुपर्ने व्यवस्था छ । तर, यमुनामाईमा आन्तरिक विवादकै कारण आर्थिक वर्ष सुरु भएको महिनौँ बितिसक्दा पनि गाउँसभा हुन सकेको छैन ।

गाउँसभा नहुँदा वार्षिक बजेट तथा कार्यक्रम पारित हुन नसकेको र नयाँ विकास योजनाको कार्यान्वयनमा समस्या भएको वडाध्यक्ष यादवले बताए । यसको असर गाउँपालिकामा कार्यरत कर्मचारीको तलबभत्तादेखि विकास निर्माणका योजनासम्म परेको उनको भनाइ छ ।

गाउँपालिकाको नेतृत्वले विवाद समाधान गरी सभा सम्पन्न गर्नुपर्नेमा उल्टै विवाद लम्ब्याउने काम भइरहेको यादवको आरोप छ ।

तालाबन्दीले सेवाग्राहीलाई सास्ती जनप्रतिनिधिबीचको विवाद अब कार्यालयको कामकाजमा समेत देखिन थालेको छ । बन्दसत्रको नाममा गाउँपालिका कार्यालयमा तालाबन्दी गरिएको र जिम्मेवार पदाधिकारी कार्यालयमा उपस्थित हुन नसक्ने अवस्था सिर्जना हुँदा नागरिकले सामान्य सेवा लिनसमेत कठिनाइ भोग्नुपरेको यादवले बताए ।

जन्मदर्ता, मृत्यु दर्ता, विवाह दर्ता, बसाइँसराइ, विभिन्न सिफारिस तथा सामाजिक सुरक्षा भत्तासम्बन्धी काम प्रभावित भएको उनको भनाइ छ ।

जनताको करबाट सञ्चालन हुने सार्वजनिक कार्यालयलाई व्यक्तिगत स्वार्थ पूरा गर्ने थलो बनाउन नहुने भन्दै यादवले कार्यालय बन्द गरेर नागरिकलाई दुःख दिने कार्य स्वीकार्य नहुने बताए ।

७० हजारको प्रलोभन देखाएर हस्ताक्षर संकलन ? गाउँपालिकाको विवाद आर्थिक पारदर्शिता र निर्णय प्रक्रियामा समेत जोडिएको छ । वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिकाको आयव्यय सार्वजनिक गर्न पटकपटक माग गर्दा पनि बेवास्ता गरिएको आरोप लगाएका छन् ।

उनका अनुसार केही वडाध्यक्ष तथा कार्यपालिका सदस्यलाई आफ्नो पक्षमा पार्न गोप्य रूपमा रजिस्टर घरघरमा पुर्‍याएर हस्ताक्षर संकलन गर्ने काम भइरहेको छ । बहुमत जुटाउने उद्देश्यले केही जनप्रतिनिधिलाई ७० हजार रुपैयाँसम्म दिने प्रलोभन देखाइएको समेत यादवको दाबी छ ।

अध्यक्षमाथि पनि मनपरी निर्णयको आरोप वडाध्यक्ष यादवले गाउँपालिका अध्यक्ष महम्मद साउद र केही वडाध्यक्षको मिलेमतोमा आफूखुसी निर्णय तथा कामकारबाही भइरहेको आरोपसमेत लगाएका छन् ।

Rautahat. Disputes and administrative misunderstandings between people's representatives in Yamunamai Rural Municipality have brought the functioning of the local government to a standstill. Even after nearly six months of the start of the fiscal year, the failure to hold village assemblies has affected development, construction, employee salaries, and even the daily services provided to the general public. Chetan Ray Yadav, ward chairman of Ward No. 4, has accused Chief Administrative Officer Brijanandan Sah of inciting conflict among the people's representatives instead of resolving the dispute within the rural municipality. According to Ward Chairman Yadav, Chief Administrative Officer Sah is trying to create an environment favorable to him by increasing mutual disagreements among elected representatives, making them competitive with each other and creating an environment favorable to him. He alleges that the administrative leadership is engaging in political maneuvering when it should create an environment of coordination and cooperation among representatives. Yadav has claimed that the situation in the municipality has become chaotic as the Chief Administrative Officer, who should have prioritized the administrative and development work of the rural municipality, has focused on personal interests and convenience. There was no village assembly for 6 months. According to the legal provisions related to the operation of local government, each local level is required to submit the budget for the upcoming fiscal year to the assembly by Asad 10. However, due to internal disputes in Yamunamai, the village assembly has not been held even after months of the start of the fiscal year. Ward Chairman Yadav said that due to the absence of a village assembly, the annual budget and programs could not be passed and there were problems in the implementation of the new development plan. He said that this has affected everything from the salaries and allowances of employees working in the rural municipality to development and construction plans. Yadav alleges that instead of the rural municipality leadership resolving the dispute and holding the meeting, the dispute is being prolonged. Lockdown causes hardship to service recipients Disputes between public representatives have now started to be seen in office operations as well. Yadav said that citizens are facing difficulties in availing even basic services as the rural municipality office has been locked in the name of closed session and responsible officials are unable to attend the office. He said that work related to birth registration, death registration, marriage registration, migration, various recommendations, and social security allowances has been affected. Stating that a public office run by the people's taxes should not be made a place to fulfill personal interests, Yadav said that causing suffering to citizens by closing the office is unacceptable. Collecting signatures by offering the lure of 70,000? The dispute in the rural municipality is also linked to financial transparency and decision-making processes. Ward Chairman Yadav has alleged that despite repeated demands to make the rural municipality's income and expenditure public, they have been ignored. According to him, work is being done to secretly collect signatures by taking the register door-to-door to win over some ward chairmen and executive members. Yadav also claims that some people's representatives have been tempted to pay up to Rs 70,000 with the aim of gaining a majority. However, the allegations of financial inducements have not been independently confirmed, and no official response from the parties involved has been made public. The chairman is also accused of arbitrary decisions. Ward Chairman Yadav has also accused the rural municipality chairman Muhammad Saud and some ward chairmen of making arbitrary decisions and taking arbitrary actions. According to him, although decisions of the rural municipality should be made according to collective consensus, financial transparency, and legal process, the functioning of the municipality has been affected due to the vested interests of a few individuals. The people are deprived of services. As the dispute within the rural municipality drags on, ordinary citizens are directly affected. Locals complain that the situation where service recipients who visit the office for tasks ranging from general recommendations to individual incident registration are not receiving services is a question of the responsibility of the local government. Stating that citizens should not suffer due to disputes between public representatives and employees, locals have demanded immediate office operations and arrangements for regular service delivery. The controversy in Yamunamai Rural Municipality has raised serious questions about the performance of the local government. The administrative situation of the municipality appears to have become weak due to the inability to hold village assemblies, the impact on budget and development projects, and the difficulty for citizens to access even basic services. Ward Chairman Yadav has demanded that the concerned bodies make the financial transactions of the rural municipality public, create an environment of cooperation among public representatives, and conduct an impartial investigation into the working style of Chief Administrative Officer Sah.

Locals complain that the situation where service recipients who visit the office for tasks ranging from general recommendations to individual incident registration are not receiving services is a question of the responsibility of the local government.

Stating that citizens should not suffer due to disputes between public representatives and employees, locals have demanded immediate office operations and arrangements for regular service delivery.

The controversy in Yamunamai Rural Municipality has raised serious questions about the performance of the local government. The administrative situation of the municipality appears to have become weak due to the inability to hold village assemblies, the impact on budget and development projects, and the difficulty for citizens to access even basic services.

Ward Chairman Yadav has demanded that the concerned bodies make the financial transactions of the rural municipality public, create an environment of cooperation among public representatives, and conduct an impartial investigation into the working style of Chief Administrative Officer Sah.
